title: Retrieval-augmented LLM with structured sampling for Building Management Systems point tagging under minimal context
task: BMS点位元数据到Brick本体类型的自动语义标注
inputData: BMS点位名称/元数据 + 少量已标注示例 + Brick本体标签空间
contribution: 提出BMS-RAG，以结构化采样构建最小但代表性的已标注上下文，动态检索相似BMS点位示例，并通过Brick本体约束的轻量校正层抑制幻觉，实现无需重新训练的跨建筑语义标注。
abstract: BMS-RAG automates Building Management Systems point-type tagging with minimal supervision. Structured sampling selects a compact context base, RAG dynamically retrieves building-specific labeled examples, and a schema-aligned rectification layer constrains outputs to a predefined ontology such as Brick. The framework is evaluated on six real-world datasets.
methodology: The decision-support workflow contains context sampling, sample labeling, dynamic retrieval, LLM point classification and label rectification. Agglomerative clustering, kNN farthest-point sampling and DBSCAN-based farthest-point sampling are studied as structured sampling strategies for choosing a small but semantically representative labeled context. For each untagged BMS point, RAG retrieves relevant labeled instances rather than relying on a static few-shot prompt. A lightweight semantic correction layer then enforces output compatibility with the Brick ontology without model retraining.
results: Across six real-world BMS datasets, BMS-RAG consistently outperforms static few-shot LLM baselines, with gains of up to 15 percentage points in F1 and several datasets reaching near or full 100% accuracy at small context sizes. Ablation studies show that structured sampling, retrieval and ontology-aligned rectification jointly reduce labeling effort and hallucinated/invalid tags.
taskEn: Automated semantic tagging of BMS points to Brick ontology classes
inputDataEn: BMS point names/metadata, a small labeled context set, and the Brick ontology label space
operationEvidence: The system retrieves analogous labeled BMS points and maps previously untagged metadata to ontology-constrained Brick point classes, which is a schema-alignment operation.
